notes: *for a wave offering* takes its supplied *for* under rule 33, the noun standing with no preposition and no object marker on it; the head is *wave*, *offering* being the supplied generic (rule 31).
*the right thigh* writes a single *the*, standing before the rectum's own attributive word, so the article takes it and the construct takes nothing (rules 28, 29).
לִפְנֵי and כַּאֲשֶׁר each fuse to one word under rule 30.
